scope: Actual immutable packaged Linux vulkan graphics request (actual rig backend recorded), portrait 720x1280 DPR1, recorded 1920x1080 source resampled into 1280x720 at requested 30 Hz synthetic camera transport, actual local face/body workers and AR, local TalkingHead PCM playback with output-waveform animation. Gesture recognition disabled. No microphone/cloud/real music, physical camera/TV/display FPS, Windows or wattage proof. Process-tree CPU; summed RSS can double-count shared memory. Idle sleep deadline accelerated from 180 s to 1.5 s for cleanup assertions. Concurrent development monitors share host; phases are indicative, not a controlled hardware benchmark.
